{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[Kaddak]'' was trained for commando operations by one of the best Mandalorian instructors. But rumor has it that he and the instructor butted heads. That he fought and killed the instructor with his bare hands.|[[Hock Malsuum]]|<ref name="DVaCoS2" />}}
A '''Mandalorian'''<ref name="DVaCoS2" /> was recruited into the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to help train the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. One of seventy-five other [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] that comprised the one-hundred person strong ''Cuy'val Dar''<ref name="GttGAR" /> the instructor trained numerous [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] for [[Commando/Legends|commando]] operations while on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and passed along knowledge of the Mandalorian culture to his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] trainees. One of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under his tutelage, who went by the self-assigned name of [[Kaddak (clone trooper)|Kaddak]], came to have a contentious relationship with the Mandalorian instructor. The two eventually fought, and using nothing but his bare [[Limb/Legends|hands]] alone, Kaddak [[Death/Legends|killed]] the instructor.<ref name="DVaCoS2" />

The Mandalorian instructor wore a suit of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] while training the clone [[Troop/Legends|troops]] assigned to him, as well as a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and [[Cape/Legends|cape]].<ref name="DVaCoS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Mandalorian instructor first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Tim Siedell]] and published [[January 15]], [[2014]].
